gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Loud, stretched-out capitals with bulky little letters, all cut at a single width by Tourney. Make that heading small and it turns cramped, while Noto Sans Glagolitic stays clear.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Tourney draws everything with a technical pen's thin, uniform line, stretched wide and athletic. Noto Sans Gothic follows with big, open counters and rounded forms like parentheses, so the text feels light.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Sturdy and friendly, Noto Sans Grantha has tall little letters whose bowls never close up, set under Tourney's wide, ring-shaped o with its constant wall. Reading on would go smoothly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Wide, muscular and unshaded, Tourney even gives its tails and terminals the full thickness of the stems. Noto Sans Gujarati works the other way, with curved strokes that stop before turning inward, and large openings.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Contemporary in feel, Tourney keeps a constant stroke weight with no sparkle, only stretched, bulky athletic letters. Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi does the quieter job, with tall crayon-thick strokes and terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Tourney shouts in wide, bulky letters where no stroke ever thins out. Yet Noto Sans Gurmukhi does the patient work, with outward-pointing terminals and ascenders that barely clear the x-height.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Every curve in Tourney matches its stems exactly, giving wide, stretched words and bulky small letters an athletic punch. Noto Sans Hanunoo, with its tall lowercase and open terminals, sits beside it quietly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Joins that stay slim as a pipe cleaner, in letters stretched wide and bulked up, mark Tourney as the loud one. Noto Sans Hebrew would read steadily, its big midsection and wide gaps keeping the line open.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK has large lowercase forms, tight ascenders and brush ends that lift away before the curve closes. And Tourney, drawn like a wire at one weight and stretched wide, gives the page its athletic shout.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aramai: Marker-line boldness, stretched wide and athletic, comes from Tourney. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic gives a friendly counterweight, its c pointing open like pincers; a modest bump up in body size would show that off.
